purpose: Exam-focused concept, comparison, lifecycle, and pattern catalogue derived from the four supplied CISM domain question sets.
sourcePolicy: Original source questions remain separate from the analysis/learning layer. Build 3 does not silently rewrite source rationales.

activeLearning.purpose: Confirm understanding through retrieval and transfer rather than repeated rereading.

adaptivePractice.repairLoop: Missed concepts are weighted into subsequent active practice sessions.

coverageExpansion: High-value active-practice variants expanded across all four supplied domains.

studyMemoryRules.purpose: Reinforce concepts inside Study using compact rules after explanation and application.

practiceExam.warning: Internal study readiness signal; not an ISACA scaled-score prediction.
